description:
Check a token before buying, sending or accepting it, on Base, Ethereum or Solana: what it is, its USD price and liquidity, and plain warnings read from the chain (no pool, thin liquidity, and on Solana an active mint or freeze authority).

$0.004 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

token.description: ERC-20 contract or SPL mint to check.

name: token_check
title: Token check
